title: Lake Louise Moraine Lake Johnston and Banff Option Bow Cascade
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Unlike standard sightseeing tours that focus on only one or two stops, this full-day experience brings together Lake Louise, Moraine Lake, Johnston Canyon, and Banff in one unforgettable journey. Guests can enjoy iconic lake views, a scenic canyon hike, and free time in Banff, with the option to choose Bow Falls and Cascade Ponds instead of Banff Town. With convenient pickup options, bottled water, and an experienced driver-guide to ensure a smooth and enjoyable day, this tour offers a more complete way to experience the beauty of Banff National Park.
